description: This file defines the Result interface used in the persistent actors' strategy evaluation, including a method to accept visitors and a static method to obtain an empty result.

classes.name: Result
classes.description: An interface representing the outcome of applying a strategy to a command, parameterized by the Event type.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Accepts a ResultVisitor to evaluate this result, typically used for visitor pattern implementation.

methods.name: empty
methods.description: Returns an empty Result instance obtained from the ResultFactory.
